system.description: This Beast can pull its prey under the surface of the ground. As an attack action, the Beast makes an attack against a target's Fortitude Defense. If the attack is successful, the target is pulled below the surface of the ground and moves -1 step on the Condition Track. The target is unable to take any Actions until it succeeds on a DC 15 Climb check as a Standard Action.
